about: Mash Pro Editor presets. Each recipe lists WHEN something happens (tied to the words) and the exact call. t = a word's start time from words.py. Colours and fonts always come from the brand kit or /motion-theme, never from the preset.

presets.name: Mash Reel Hook
presets.base_look: Bold Impact or Ali Abdaal Clean
presets.captions: kinetic captions, one glowing key word per phrase

recipe.call: MP.title('#front', t, { at: 'bottom', lead: '<first words>', word: '<HOOK WORD>', cam: '#cam', shake: 'lens', hold: 1.4 })
MP.steps('#front', t, ['one', 'two', 'three'], { each: <gap between words> , top: '62%' })
MP.endCard('#front', t, { line: '<closing line>', cta: '<follow / link>' })

presets.sound: hit on hook, pop on key words, swipe on the end card underline; soft music

presets.name: Mash YouTube Explainer
presets.pace: calm: a graphic every 4-8 s, smooth zooms on impact lines

recipe.call: MP.callout('#front', t, { x, y, text: '<label>', hold: 2.5 })

presets.sound: swipe on lower third, pop on callouts/steps, whoosh on section whips; voice-only is fine

presets.name: Mash SaaS Launch
presets.base_look: Dark Neon or Clean SaaS Glass
presets.captions: big kinetic words as the copy

recipe.call: MP.bg('#bg', { colors, style: 'fluid', dur }); MP.text('#h1', t, 'scramble')
MP.cursor('#stage', [[t, x, y], [t2, x2, y2, true, '.ui']]); MP.zoom('.ui', t2, { x: '70%', y: '30%', scale: 1.8, hold: 1 })
MP.endCard('#front', t, { line: '<product>', cta: '<try it free>' })

presets.sound: whoosh on screen entrances, click on cursor clicks, swipe on carousel, pop on numbers

presets.name: Mash Apple Glass
presets.pace: slow and premium: one idea per 2-3 s
presets.captions: thin serif + bold pairs, lots of space

recipe.call: MP.bg('#bg', { colors, style: 'aurora', dur }); MP.text('#h1', t, 'tracking')

presets.sound: very few: shimmer on reveals, one hit on the final title

presets.name: Mash Vox Map
presets.pace: explainer: map moves follow the narration

recipe.call: const m = MP.map('#map', { center, zoom: 1 }); m.flyTo(t, [lon, lat], 4)

presets.sound: whoosh on flyTo, shimmer on highlight, pop on pins, swipe on routes

presets.name: Mash Data Story
presets.sound: swipe on charts, pop as numbers land. Only real numbers from the user or the script.

presets.name: Mash Beat Edit

recipe.call: MP.onBeats(beats.beats, (t, i) => MP.text('#w' + i, t, 'pop', { sfx: false }), { every: 2 })

presets.sound: the music carries the beat: no SFX on beat effects, music louder than usual (no voice)

presets.name: Mash Podcast Clip

recipe.call: python3 mash-pro/scripts/silence.py ep.mp4 --xml cut.xml; python3 mash-pro/scripts/resize.py ep_cut.mp4 --to 9:16 --focus <speaker x 0-1>

presets.sound: voice first; one hit on the best line; music optional and very soft

presets.name: Mash Real Estate

recipe.call: MP.callout('#front', t, { x, y, text: '<feature>', hold: 2 })
const m = MP.map('#map', { center, zoom: 6 }); m.pin(t, [lon, lat], '<area>')

presets.sound: shimmer on light leaks, pop on callouts, soft music

presets.name: Mash Construction
presets.sound: hit on heavy moments, whoosh on before/after

presets.name: Mash Creator
presets.captions: English key words only if the speech is not English

recipe.call: MP.title('#front', t, { lead: '<small line>', word: '<BIG WORD>', hold: 1.6 })

presets.sound: light: pop and swipe only, or voice only

presets.name: Mash Bold Impact

recipe.call: MP.impact('#kw', '#cam', t, { text: 'stretch', shake: 'glitch' }); MP.shake('#cam', t, 'whiteFlicker', { sfx: false })

presets.sound: hits on punchlines, clicks on glitches; keep SFX at -17 dB so it never gets harsh
